projectBackground.name: Store Network Refresh — Grocery Category Review
projectBackground.context: The beverages and snacks ranges are overstocked. You must decide what to cut and what to mark down.

manager.name: Claire Whitfield
manager.role: Head of Trading, Nova Retail Group
manager.note: Space is money. Every product earns its place on margin and turn.

assignment.title: Fix the category
assignment.brief: Calculate margin, markdown effect and turns, compare categories in Excel and recommend range changes.

documents.name: Markdown Plan
documents.note: Item priced at €80, cost €48; 25% markdown proposed.

tasks.title: Gross Margin %
tasks.prompt: Selling price €50, cost €32. What is gross margin (%)?
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Margin After Markdown
tasks.prompt: An item at €80 is marked down 25% (to €60); cost €48. What is the margin after markdown (%)?
tasks.mistake: Assuming margin is unchanged is wrong.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Stock Turn
tasks.prompt: COGS €1,200,000 and average inventory €200,000. What is the stock turn?
tasks.reasoning: Turn shows how fast stock sells.
tasks.mistake: Using sales instead of COGS overstates turn.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Planogram
tasks.prompt: What is the main purpose of a planogram?
options: To place products on shelves to maximise sales and availability
tasks.mistake: Ignoring data keeps slow items in prime spots.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Category Margin (Excel)
tasks.prompt: Gross margin % in column D = (B - C) / B x 100.
tasks.reasoning: Snacks earn the best margin; dairy the lowest.
tasks.mistake: Cutting low-margin traffic drivers hurts overall sales.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Range Recommendation
tasks.modelAnswer: Snacks deliver a 35% margin and should keep prime shelf space, while dairy at 20% is a traffic driver we retain but price carefully. Overstocked beverages (25% margin) should be reduced by delisting the two slowest SKUs and marking down the rest by no more than 25%, which still leaves a 20% margin. Stock turn of 6 is acceptable but should rise to 7 by month three.
tasks.reasoning: A good recommendation uses margin and turn to decide and sets a target.
tasks.mistake: Cutting by gut feel loses customers.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

caseStudy.title: Case Study: The Markdown Spiral
caseStudy.background: A retailer discounted slow lines by 50% every month. Margin fell 6 points and customers waited for sales.
caseStudy.challenges: No markdown plan or buy discipline.
caseStudy.solution: Nova introduced buy-to-sell planning and capped markdown steps.
caseStudy.lessonsLearned: Fix the buy, not just the price.
